manaNeeded: {3}{G}{W}{W}{W} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable and {0} plus the mana cost of the creature in your hand
easyPrerequisites: Changeling Hero must be exiled by Fiend Hunter, and Yannik must begin in hand. (This starting order is not fixed, and their initial positions may be interchanged as necessary.)
description:
Cast Yannik by paying {2}{G}{W} and commander tax, if applicable.
Yannik enters the battlefield, exiling Changeling Hero and distributing a number of +1/+1 counters equal to Changeling Hero's power among creatures you control.
The creature that was championed by Changeling Hero returns to the battlefield from exile.
Cast Fiend Hunter by paying {1}{W}{W}.
Fiend Hunter enters the battlefield, exiling Yannik.
Changeling Hero returns to the battlefield from exile, championing Fiend Hunter.
Fiend Hunter leaves the battlefield, returning Yannik to the battlefield from exile.
Yannik enters the battlefield, exiling Changeling Hero and distributing a number of +1/+1 counters equal to Changeling Hero's power among creatures you control.
Changeling Hero leaves the battlefield, returning Fiend Hunter to the battlefield from exile.
Repeat from step 5.
Cast Yannik for its mana cost.
When Yannik enters, it exiles Fiend Hunter until Yannik leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Yannik's ETB.
When Fiend Hunter leaves the battlefield, Changeling Hero is returned from exile to the battlefield.
When Changeling Hero enters, it exiles Yannik until Changeling Hero leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Changeling Hero's ETB.
When Yannik leaves the battlefield, Fiend Hunter is returned from exile to the battlefield.
When Fiend Hunter enters, it exiles Changeling Hero until Fiend Hunter leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Fiend Hunter's ETB.
When Changeling Hero leaves the battlefield, Yannik is returned from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
